comparisons.questionText: Who are your target customers? Define your audience as specifically as possible. (Demographics, Psychographics)

pre.answer: Modern, career-driven women aged 24-38 (120k+ a year) who appreciate minimalist luxury and invest in timeless, high-quality pieces over quantity of pieces, building a collection. (They prioritize ethical craftsmanship, follow brands like COS and The Row, and seek effortlessly elegant jewelry that aligns with their values of sustainability and sophistication.)

post.answer: High-achieving, career-driven, urban women aged 24-38, earning $120K+ annually, who appreciate minimalist luxury and invest in timeless, high-quality pieces to build a refined jewelry collection. They prioritize craftsmanship and longevity over trends, choosing understated elegance over flashy statement pieces. They follow brands like COS, The Row, and Toteme, value quiet luxury, and seek jewelry that seamlessly integrates into their wardrobe. While they appreciate ethical production, their primary focus is on quality, design, and exclusivity.
